text: dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine 面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 提供 OME 工程交付预设，将需求定义、计划、构建、验证、评审、交付和复盘接入系统提示、工具与会话事件。用户可启动运行、记录阶段证据、查看状态、推进或取消流程；计划须由用户显式审批，验证证据须关联同一会话中的成功工具调用。完成后可写入 OME Memory。另含预设安装、更新和移除命令，使用 DSH_HOME 或默认 ~/.dsh，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine adds an OME engineering preset to DSH Web and Desktop. It guides work through gated stages, records session evidence, requires user plan approval, and saves completion memory. Tools manage runs; a CLI installs, updates, or removes the preset. It uses DSH_HOME or ~/.dsh.
我想让工程任务按定义、计划、构建和验证这些阶段逐步推进。
怎样要求用户先批准计划，之后再进入实施阶段？
我需要在会话里记录每个交付阶段的证据和当前状态。
DSH 能不能只让根 Agent 推进工程流程，子 Agent 只能查询进度？
我想把已完成的交付结果写成 OME Memory 记录。
有没有办法在同一个 DSH 会话中取消正在进行的工程流程？
I want an engineering workflow that requires explicit user approval before implementation.
How can I track stage evidence and completion memory in my DSH session?
dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine 的功能「阶段流程管理」：在 DSH 会话启动工程运行并记录阶段证据。用 ome_start、ome_record_evidence、ome_advance 提交请求或证据，查看状态与下一步。
dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine 的功能「计划审批」：计划阶段必须由用户显式运行 /ome-approve 才能通过审批门禁。命令记录用户批准事件并允许后续推进；Agent 不能自行批准计划。
dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine 的功能「验证证据关联」：验证记录须引用同一会话中先前成功的 DSH 工具调用。ome_status 列出可引用调用，ome_record_evidence 接收调用 ID 并保存证据。
dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine 的功能「预设生命周期」：dsh-ome preset install、update、remove 可安装、更新或移除预设。更新会先备份；未管理或已修改的预设目录不能更新或移除。
dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine 的功能「运行状态命令」：用户可用 /ome-status 查看当前运行阶段、证据数量、阻塞项和下一步，也可用 /ome-cancel [reason] 取消当前运行并附上原因。
dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine 的使用须知：预设安装位置由 DSH_HOME 决定；若未设置则使用用户目录下的 ~/.dsh，并写入其中的 .agent-presets/ome-engineer。

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine：`dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine` adds the isolated `ome-engineer` preset to DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop profiles. It keeps Oh My Engine platform-neutral: the plugin consumes OME's public lifecycle API and stores runtime state only in the active DSH Session Event Log.

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · Install：Download the prebuilt package from the pinned GitHub Release. It includes the OME package built from the verified upstream commit, so neither package has to be published to npm and installation does not need Git or GitHub SSH:

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · Install：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/oh-my-engine/dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine/releases/download/v0.1.6/dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine-0.1.6.tgz
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/oh-my-engine/dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine/releases/download/v0.1.6/dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine-0.1.6.tgz
dsh plugin --profile desktop exec dsh-ome preset install
```

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · Install：The plugin CLI is profile-local and is intentionally not added to the system `PATH`. Run it through the profile where the package is installed; replace `desktop` with `web` when installing only the Web profile.

Restart the profile host and select **OME 工程化模式**. The bundle patch only registers the OME Session Event Log vocabulary needed for cold-start resume; Standard, Code, Minimal, and other presets receive no OME tools, commands, or prompt changes.

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · `EADDRINUSE` when starting DSH Web：The plugin installer does not start a web server. `EADDRINUSE 127.0.0.1:3080` means another DSH Web process already owns the default port; it is not an OME plugin installation failure. Diagnose it without platform-specific process commands:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-ome doctor
```

Reuse the already-running UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, stop that process normally, or let DSH choose another free port:

```powershell
dsh web --port 0 --no-open
```

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · `EADDRINUSE` when starting DSH Web：Preset lifecycle operations are explicit:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop exec dsh-ome preset update
dsh plugin --profile desktop exec dsh-ome preset remove
```

Update creates a complete backup. Update and remove refuse unmanaged or locally modified preset directories. Removing the plugin from a DSH Profile does not remove the preset, and removing the preset does not uninstall the Profile plugin.

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · Role protocol：- `/ome-init` initializes OME without force or implicit overwrite.
- `/ome-approve` is the only accepted Plan approval source.
- `/ome-status` reads the current Session state.
- `/ome-cancel [reason]` cancels the current run.
- OME model tools manage lifecycle events only; DSH native tools retain ownership of edits, commands, sandboxing, approvals, and cancellation.
- Test evidence must reference a successful prior tool call in the same Session.
- Subagents inherit context but can only call `ome_status`.

dsh-plugin-oh-my-engine README · Role protocol：First release support is Web and Desktop against DSH/Cordis `0.1.1-rc.2`. Re-run profile and Session compatibility checks before upgrading DSH.

See [OME Engineering Mode architecture, installation, acceptance, and rollback](docs/OME_ENGINEERING_MODE.md) for the complete delivery guide.
